name: Museum Apprentice Program
what_you_do: Train as a museum educator. You meet artists and curators, plan lessons, help with family programs, and lead tours for summer camp groups.
who_can_apply: All New York City high school students.
pay_detail: $17 per hour. Second-year apprentices are leaders and earn $18 per hour. Up to 180 hours for the year. OMNY cards for weekend and summer work.
duration: November 2026 to August 2027: Thursdays 4:30 to 6:30 PM during the school year, then Wednesday to Friday 10 AM to 4 PM in July and August.
deadline_text: The 2026 to 2027 deadline has passed. The page says to come back in June 2027 to apply for the fall 2027 program.
how_to_apply: Online application through the link on the program page when it is open.
notes: You must commit to the full schedule, including summer. Questions: teen.programs@brooklynmuseum.org.
